label: Flow

projection.consumedFor: Task → Run → Receipt lineage rows, depends-on edges vs blocked state, executor identity, canonical produces/proves proof, typed stale-fence/unverifiable-fence gaps, explicit missing-run/missing-receipt labels

lineage.join: explicit ids only: run.taskId, receipt.runId, executes edges (agent→run), produces edges (run→receipt), proves edges (receipt→task), contains edges (work→mission→task for workId filters); never name/title joins
lineage.order: tasks deduplicated by taskId and stable-sorted by taskId; runs deduplicated by runId and stable-sorted by runId; receipts deduplicated by receiptId and stable-sorted by receiptId; input order never changes visible truth
lineage.lookupSafety: Node lookups use Map and browser lookup dictionaries are prototype-safe (Object.create(null)), so hostile ids such as __proto__, constructor, or prototype never corrupt membership

fields.columns: deterministic Task → Run → Receipt columns with visible directional paths (aria-hidden in the visual representation; the accessible linear list carries readable direction text)
fields.dependencies: depends-on edges and task.dependencyIds render as their own facts; a blocked task status renders as a separate fact — dependencies never masquerade as blockers
fields.fenceTruth: stale or unverifiable fences render only from typed stale-fence/unverifiable-fence gaps; rejected runs may be absent as run nodes and the gap is the truth; no current fence, stale fence, accepted run, or readiness value is ever invented
fields.executor: executor identity renders only from canonical executes edges resolving to canonical agent nodes; an unresolvable executor renders the honest label 'executor not present in projection' and the raw id never renders
fields.proof: only exact canonical produces (run→receipt) and proves (receipt→task) edges render as proof; bounded receipt ids and receipt status only — never raw evidence refs, raw digests, payloads, prompts, tokens, Telegram auth, or private client data
fields.missing: a task with no accepted run renders 'run not present in projection'; an accepted run with no canonical receipt renders 'receipt not present in projection'; causes are never invented and typed source gaps render separately

filters.rules: explicit IDs/enums only: workId scopes through contains edges, agentId matches executes relationships plus task.assignedAgentId, state matches canonical task status; filters are bounded and secret-filtered; title text never matches; secret-bearing filter input matches nothing and never echoes

derivation.empty: no task rows survive the projection or the explicit filters
derivation.truncated: combined visible Task/Run/Receipt fact nodes exceed the 96 bound; overflow renders the exact copy 'showing 96 of N'

density.bounds: the combined visible Task/Run/Receipt fact nodes are bounded at 96 after a deterministic column+ID stable sort (all tasks, then runs, then receipts in canonical ID order); truncation renders the exact copy 'showing 96 of N' and rows beyond the bound never fabricate receipt truth

representations.graph: a visual table with Task/Run/Receipt columns and aria-hidden directional path markup; no force simulation and no animation is required to read direction
representations.linear: an accessible ordered list fallback carrying readable direction text per row; linear facts stay semantic and never aria-hidden
representations.parity: the two representations expose the exact same unique fact-ID set; visual duplicate markup is aria-hidden

authority.governedActions: every governed action delegates to the existing signed Gate client (POST /api/gate/{tenant}) via its frozen hook; this slice exposes no safe hook, so the scene renders no direct actions and defers activation wiring to Task 11
authority.forbidden: no write path, no Gate/RBAC/assignment logic, no fetch, no event handlers, no copied signing, no initData handling, and no client-authored state transitions inside the scene

accessibility.structure: rows are table rows with labelled facts plus a semantic ordered-list fallback; typed gaps use role=status
accessibility.announcements: empty/error states use role=status via the shared FabricState renderer

redaction: no initData, tokens, raw evidence refs, raw digests, prompt material, or client payloads render; proof renders bounded receipt ids/status through canonical produces/proves edges only; every projection-derived string passes the Task 7 escaping/fail-closed policy. The Node substrate embeds the canonical Task 7 signature regex VERBATIM (query_id=|auth_date=|\bhash=|Bearer\s|bot_token|clientSecret|initData|TELEGRAM_INIT_DATA|TG_INIT_DATA|QUESTS_PUSH_TOKEN|token=|PRIVATE KEY|\bprompt\s*[:=]|prompt\s+injection); the served browser substrate expresses the same policy as a legible normalized grammar — (?:query_id|auth_date|token)=|(?:^|\W)(?:hash)= plus the remaining explicit canonical terms — boolean-equivalent by the generated adversarial matrix with zero divergences; no character-class fragmentation, no split/concatenated forms
